GASOIL.error: ICE low-sulphur gasoil is the European diesel benchmark, but no free source publishes its daily settlements: ICE's own data is licensed and Yahoo carries no gasoil future. Without a price history the desk has no range, volatility or momentum to show. ICE's weekly Commitments of Traders report is free, so the Positioning tab carries gasoil; for a price read, NY Harbor ULSD (heating oil) is the nearest freely published distillate benchmark.
